description: For the customers find_rebook_customers lists as 'not_looked_up', read their name, phone and email from the business's booking system and save them as past customers, so the list can be emailed and called. Past customers raise no new-lead alerts and are never put in Kai call or text campaigns. Reads a few customers a minute (the booking system's limit), so one call may not finish: when remaining is above 0, call again. A customer that cannot be read stays on the list. Sends nothing. Requires an admin of the business.

business_id.description: Required when the account has more than one business.

holiday.description: Compare this holiday's week last year with the same week this year (Monday to Sunday around the holiday; Memorial Day and Labor Day take the seven days ending on the holiday; new-years is the week of New Year's Eve). Use this or this_year_start/this_year_end.

last_year_end.description: Optional: last day of the earlier range.

last_year_start.description: Optional: first day of the earlier range. Default: the same weekdays 52 weeks before.

this_year_end.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive, at most 92 days).

this_year_start.description: Optional instead of holiday: first day, YYYY-MM-DD.

year.description: Optional with holiday: the year to fill (default: this year). Last year's week is the year before.
